newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Federal completes $45 mln offer.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Federal completes $45 mln offer.

text.p: Commercial Federal Corp said Thursday it completed a public offering of $45 million of 9.375 percent cumulative trust preferred securities.
In a release dated May 14, the offering was made through its Delaware trust subsidiary, CFC Preferred Trust, and underwritten by Piper Jaffray Inc and Dain Bosworth Inc.
The securities are listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol CFBPr.

Proceeds from the offering will be invested in Junior Subordinated Deferrable Interest Debentures issued by Commercial Federal. The debentures mature on May 15, 2027, and can be redeemed after May 15, 2002.

The company said it plans to use the proceeds from the sale of the debentures for general corporate purposes, including possible future acquisitions, investments in subsidiaries, repayment of obligations and redemption of securities.
Commercial Federal is the parent company of Commercial Federal Bank, a federal savings bank which operates 107 retail branches.
